finalText:
**Drafted 4.2.0 into `CHANGELOG.md`.** Out of 380 commits, 14 things matter.

Three break people:
1. Internal error types are no longer re-exported. That was 8 commits.
2. The v1 export route is gone.
3. An expired token answers 401 now, not 403.

One new thing. Failed webhook deliveries retry on their own.

Ten real fixes, grouped. The same bug got fixed in several modules.

Two calls I made for you. The 401 change was tagged `fix`, but clients branch on status codes, so I put it under Breaking. I left the speed work out, since your template allows only three headings.
